annotations.title: Get one issue, page by page

description: The pages of one issue of a paper on a date, in order, with each page's id, image (where the archive holds one), reader link and the holding library's copy. Use to walk an issue, or to learn whether the archive holds a paper on a given day. If the archive holds no issue that day it gives the issues it holds either side and how many days apart they are, and names the gap when they are more than 14 days apart.

edition.description: Only for a date with more than one edition.

paper.description: "St. Croix Avis", "The West End News", "Home Journal", "St. Croix Tribune", or a slug.
